title: Orbital Fish Animation Conductor
description: A BarramundiFish orbits around a central ShaderBall2 acting as a mystical aquatic orb. The user conducts the animation by adjusting orbit radius, speed, wave amplitude, rotation axis tilt, fish scale, and trail intensity through an interactive control panel, with each parameter validated in real-time.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (via importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that loads BarramundiFish.glb and ShaderBall2.glb using GLTFLoader. Place ShaderBall2 at the scene origin scaled to roughly 1.5 units, acting as a glowing aquatic orb. Add a subtle emissive-like point light (cyan, intensity 3) inside it. The BarramundiFish should orbit the ShaderBall2 in a sinusoidal 3D path. Set up a PerspectiveCamera at (0, 3, 8) looking at origin, with OrbitControls enabled. Add ambient light (intensity 0.4) and a directional light from (5, 10, 5). Create an HTML control panel (fixed, top-right, dark semi-transparent background) with 6 labeled range sliders: (1) Orbit Radius: 1.5–6.0, default 3.0, step 0.1; (2) Orbit Speed: 0.1–3.0, default 1.0, step 0.1; (3) Wave Amplitude: 0.0–2.0, default 0.5, step 0.1 — controls vertical sine oscillation; (4) Axis Tilt: 0–80 degrees, default 15, step 1 — tilts the orbital plane; (5) Fish Scale: 0.5–4.0, default 2.0, step 0.1; (6) Trail Opacity: 0.0–1.0, default 0.5, step 0.05 — controls a trailing ribbon effect behind the fish using a TubeGeometry or line of small transparent spheres that fades. Each slider must validate its value on input: clamp to min/max, display current numeric value beside the slider, and reject non-numeric input. In the animation loop, compute fish position as x=radius*cos(time*speed), z=radius*sin(time*speed), y=amplitude*sin(time*speed*2), rotated by axisTilt around the Z-axis. Orient the fish tangent to its path using lookAt on the next computed position. Update trail geometry each frame by storing the last 40 positions and rendering them as small spheres with decreasing opacity based on Trail Opacity. The ShaderBall2 should slowly rotate on its Y-axis. Add a visible text overlay showing 'Orbital Fish Conductor' as a title. Ensure smooth 60fps animation and responsive layout.
